race.comment: LINCHPIN (2) stuck on well when out to the mile behind Street Band, Westbound and co. last start. Back to 1400m looks a big tick for him, though he'll need a touch of luck from the barrier. Gone to a new level his past couple however and he can continue his upward trajectory. SNOW GOD (3) flew home behind Rock Fest two back before a plain effort last start over this track and trip. He's likely to be back in the run again, but the quick turnaround looks a good move and McGruddy hops back aboard. A better effort is on the cards. STREAMLINED (9) flew home to be 1L away last start as favourite over 1800m and now drops back to 1400m. That's some query, but he's a two-time winner at the trip and he maps well for Brad Parnham. Creates some interest. MARKET SNITZ (6) remained unbeaten with a gutsy win when wide throughout last start. Tricky gate but he's a nice horse on the rise. BONDI'S FUTURE (5) is better than he showed last start and can bounce back third-up.
